summary: Completed comprehensive regression testing of HRIS & Payroll SaaS after MongoDB to MariaDB migration. Tested 156 backend API endpoints and 11 frontend UI pages. Overall success rate: 95.5% (149/156 passed). The MariaDB migration is SUCCESSFUL - SQL translation layer correctly handles all Mongo-style queries including filters ($ne, $in, $nin, $regex, $or), sort, pagination, JSON columns, $set/$inc/$push operations, duplicate detection, and tenant isolation.
